statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; ∀ (n U B : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ B → let T := fun m : ℕ => ∑ a ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun a => B < a ∧ U < m / a), (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors a).filter (fun d => U < d), μ d) * Λ (m/a); (∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (T m:ℂ)*E ((m:ℝ)*t)) = -(∑ b ∈ Finset.Ioc U (n/(B+1)), ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 U, ((Λ b * μ d:ℝ):ℂ) * ∑ l ∈ Finset.Ioc (B/d) ((n/b)/d), E ((b*d*l:ℕ)*t))

brief.zh: a>B≥1 时全 Möbius 除数和为零。把补和取负，写 a=dℓ，保留 b≤n/(B+1) 和 ℓ 的两个取整端点。取 B=⌊n^(2/3)⌋。
brief.en: For a>B≥1 the full Möbius divisor sum vanishes. Negate the short complement, set a=dℓ and keep both floors and b≤n/(B+1). Use B=⌊n^(2/3)⌋.
